_note: Quaternius' authoritative values. The runtime should use these; the editor viewport applies them too so light strips read correctly while laying out.

transparency._note: The .gltf export flattened these to OPAQUE - Quaternius' own shaders make them see-through, and the glTF has no way to say 'alpha driven by scrolling noise'. The kit's own pale green read too faint at the top of a lit room, so these are the values judged in the Sandbox against the real ship: a deep green (0, 109, 11), half alpha, and an ior of 1 to take the sheen off the pane.

editorViewport._note: Emissive intensities of 10-20 are correct for a baked-lighting runtime but blow out an unlit layout viewport, so they are damped here only.
